entries.en: Added `autoMode.classifyAllShell` setting to route all Bash/PowerShell commands through the auto-mode classifier instead of only arbitrary-code-execution patterns
entries.zh: 添加了`autoMode.classifyAllShell`设置，以通过自动模式分类器路由所有 Bash/PowerShell 命令，而不仅仅是任意代码执行模式

entries.en: Added auto-mode denial reasons to the transcript, the denial toast, and `/permissions` recent denials
entries.zh: 在记录、拒绝 toast 和`/permissions`最近拒绝中添加了自动模式拒绝原因

entries.en: Added `claude_code.assistant_response` OpenTelemetry log event containing the model's response text. Redacted unless `OTEL_LOG_ASSISTANT_RESPONSES=1`; when that var is unset it follows `OTEL_LOG_USER_PROMPTS`, so deployments that already log prompt content will start receiving response content on upgrade — set `OTEL_LOG_ASSISTANT_RESPONSES=0` to keep prompts-only.
entries.zh: 添加了包含模型响应文本的`claude_code.assistant_response` OpenTelemetry 日志事件。已编辑，除非`OTEL_LOG_ASSISTANT_RESPONSES=1`；当该变量未设置时，它遵循`OTEL_LOG_USER_PROMPTS`，因此已经记录提示内容的部署将在升级时开始接收响应内容 - 设置`OTEL_LOG_ASSISTANT_RESPONSES=0`以仅保留提示。

entries.en: Added live file path autocomplete to bash mode (`!`)
entries.zh: 向 bash 模式添加了实时文件路径自动完成功能 (`!`)

entries.en: Added a startup notice when MCP servers need authentication, pointing at `/mcp`
entries.zh: 添加了 MCP 服务器需要身份验证时的启动通知，指向`/mcp`

entries.en: Added automatic memory-pressure reaping for idle background shell commands (disable with `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BG_SHELL_PRESSURE_REAP=1`)
entries.zh: 为空闲后台 shell 命令添加了自动内存压力收获（使用`CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BG_SHELL_PRESSURE_REAP=1`禁用）

entries.en: Improved background agents: the launch result no longer instructs Claude to "end your response" — it keeps working on other tasks while the agent runs
entries.zh: 改进后台 agent：启动结果不再指示 Claude“结束你的回复”，代理运行期间它会继续处理其他任务

entries.en: Improved MCP `headersHelper` auth: the helper now re-runs and reconnects automatically when a tool call returns 401/403
entries.zh: 改进 MCP `headersHelper` 认证：工具调用返回 401/403 时，辅助程序会自动重新运行并重新连接

entries.en: Improved plugin auto-rename: marketplace `renames` maps are now followed automatically, updating your settings to the new name
entries.zh: 改进插件自动重命名：现在会自动遵循市场中的 `renames` 映射，并把你的设置更新为新名称

entries.en: Improved `/add-dir` message when the directory is already a working directory
entries.zh: 改进 `/add-dir` 的提示：目录已经是工作目录时，给出更清楚的信息

entries.en: Fixed `/model` and other client-data-gated UI showing stale/empty state immediately after `/login`
entries.zh: 修复了`/model`和其他客户端数据门控 UI 在`/login`后立即显示陈旧/空状态的问题

entries.en: Fixed backgrounding (←←) spuriously cancelling with "N background tasks would be abandoned" when all running tasks carry over to the new session
entries.zh: 当所有正在运行的任务转移到新会话时，修复了后台 (←←) 虚假取消“N 个后台任务将被放弃”的问题

entries.en: Fixed pinned background agents being re-prompted to "Continue from where you left off" after every auto-update
entries.zh: 修复了每次自动更新后固定的后台代理都会重新提示“从上次中断的地方继续”的问题

entries.en: Fixed backgrounding the main turn spawning a phantom "general-purpose (resumed)" subagent that re-ran the main conversation
entries.zh: 修复了主要回合的后台生成一个幻影“通用（已恢复）”子代理，该子代理重新运行主要对话

entries.en: Fixed agent panel hiding sibling agents when viewing a subagent
entries.zh: 修复了查看子代理时代理面板隐藏同级代理的问题
